attach_to: guid of message bubble to attach the sticker to
bb_events: include dylib-pushed events (typing, alias-removed) when injection is active
bc_text: backwards-compat text shown to older clients (default: same as new-text)
chat_id: Limit stats to a chat rowid
comment: optional override for the caption text; defaults to --question. Sent as a plain message right after the poll, matching Messages' native 'comment or Send' field
convert_attachments: convert CAF/GIF attachments to model-compatible cached files
duration: how long to show typing (e.g. 5s, 3000ms); omit for start-only
effect: expressive send id (impact, loud, gentle, invisibleink, confetti, …)
format_file: path to JSON file containing the format ranges array
local: list accounts from local chat.db history (no SIP / bridge required)
name: string
group display name
no_comment: do not echo the question as a caption after the poll
no_contacts: Skip Contacts lookups and return raw handles
option: poll option text; pass at least twice
option_id: vote/unvote: UUID of the option to select
parts_file: path to JSON file containing parts array
path: original_path of a downloaded Messages attachment, from history.
photo: image file to use as photo (set)
poll: vote/unvote: guid of the poll message to update
question: string

poll question. Messages does not render the poll title on the balloon, so imsg sends this as a plain caption message right after the poll (the visible text) and also stores it as the payload title for agent readback
reaction: reaction type: love, like, dislike, laugh, emphasis, question
reactions: include reaction events (tapback add/remove) in the stream
remove: remove this reaction instead of adding
reply_to: guid of message to reply to
shell: Shell completion format: bash, zsh or fish.
stop: stop typing indicator instead of starting
subject: string
subject line
time_zone: IANA time zone for date buckets (defaults to local)
unread_only: Return only chats with unread inbound messages
url: URL to send as a rich link preview
x: sticker center across the bubble: 0 left, 1 right (default 0.5)
y: sticker center down the bubble: 0 top, 1 bottom (default 0.5)

events.description: Observe live bridge events, such as typing, for a bounded window.

group.description: Show chat identity and participants for a chat id.

history_options.description: Show recent messages for a chat.

name_photo_set.description: Inspect, share, or set your Messages Name & Photo (set).

name_photo_share.description: Inspect, share, or set your Messages Name & Photo (share).

name_photo_status.description: Inspect, share, or set your Messages Name & Photo (status).

notify_anyways.description: Force a notification for a message that was filtered/suppressed.
